faq_heading: Homes near Josette Dandurand Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Josette Dandurand Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Josette Dandurand Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Josette Dandurand Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Josette Dandurand Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 265 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,715,000, townhomes $870,000, condos $600,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Josette Dandurand Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary the median was 18 days on the market, closing at 98.1% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 265 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Josette Dandurand Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peter Ewart Middle School (1.0 km south), Yorkson Creek Middle School (1.1 km east) and Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

Josette Dandurand Elementary is an elementary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20143 82 Avenue. It teaches grades K to 5.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Josette Dandurand Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Josette Dandurand Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Josette Dandurand Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 265 homes sold within 1 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary: 11 houses, 131 townhomes and 105 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $870,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Josette Dandurand Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Peter Ewart Middle School, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is James Kennedy Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.1 km south-east), Willoughby Elementary (1.4 km south-east), Dorothy Peacock Elementary (1.7 km north), Lynn Fripps Elementary (1.8 km east), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (1.9 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, 1.1 km south-east of Josette Dandurand Elementary.
